name: group_ids
title: Lookup Users and Groups on a system

origin.description:
These functions use the GETPWENT(3) and GETGRENT(3) system calls to query
users and groups respectively.
origin.details:
These functions use the GETPWENT(3) and GETGRENT(3) system calls to query
users and groups respectively.
origin.value:
They return their results in a data.frame. On windows both
functions return an empty data.frame because windows does not have user
or group ids.
origin.example:
# list first 6 groups
head(group_ids())

# list first 6 users
head(user_ids())

translation.description:
These functions use the GETPWENT(3) and GETGRENT(3) system calls to query
users and groups respectively.
translation.details:
These functions use the GETPWENT(3) and GETGRENT(3) system calls to query
users and groups respectively.
translation.value:
They return their results in a data.frame. On windows both
functions return an empty data.frame because windows does not have user
or group ids.
translation.example:
groups = group_ids()
users = user_ids()
print("group_id", "group_name")
for index in range(6):
    print(groups["group_id"][index], groups["group_name"][index])
print("user_id", "user_name")
for index in range(6):
    print(users["user_id"][index], users["user_name"][index])
